transcript: So today I want to talk about something that I think a lot of people get wrong. When I started training I made three mistakes and honestly they cost me about a year of progress. The first one is that I was changing my programme every two weeks because I saw a new split online. The second is that I was tracking nothing, no weights, no reps, nothing. And the third is that I was eating way under maintenance without realising it. If you fix those three things you will grow. Follow for more.
topic: Three common beginner training mistakes that stall natural muscle growth
